name: com.crosscheckapi/crosscheck
title: crosscheck
description: Independent second opinion on an agent's draft before its human sees it. Paid per check over x402.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSCHECK_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated EVM wallet with a few dollars of USDC on Base (or test USDC on Base Sepolia). Pays for checks.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSCHECK_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to pay more than this per check. Default 0.10.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSCHECK_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Networks to pay on, in order of preference. Default eip155:8453,eip155:84532. Set eip155:84532 for test USDC only.
